lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\ElementMatrix\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
appinfo/info.xml names 2 classes that appinfo/ and lib/ do not have. The server fails when it comes to load one.
OCA\ElementMatrix\Settings\AdminSection, admin section in <settings><admin-section>
OCA\ElementMatrix\Command\SyncRooms, command in <commands><command>

Nothing in the app calls 4 routes outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 1 file of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. The frontend puts the path of the app and the rest of a URL together at run time, so every text there that reads like a path below the app counted as a call. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).
POST /index.php/apps/elementmatrix/api/v1/room/{token}/participants/active  elementmatrix.room.joinroom  appinfo/routes.php:2 routes
POST /index.php/apps/elementmatrix/api/v1/admin/settings  elementmatrix.adminsettings.savesettings  appinfo/routes.php:2 routes
GET /index.php/apps/elementmatrix/api/v1/integration/contacts  elementmatrix.integration.getcontacts  appinfo/routes.php:2 routes
POST /index.php/apps/elementmatrix/api/v1/integration/calendar/events  elementmatrix.integration.createcalendarevent  appinfo/routes.php:2 routes
The frontend or a template builds 1 URL below /apps/elementmatrix/ that no route of the app matches. The request fails at run time.

GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/elementmatrix/api/v4/rooms  ocs.elementmatrix.room.getrooms  appinfo/routes.php:2 ocs
The app has 4 OCS routes and no openapi.json. Clients of OCS are generated from such a specification, and nothing else tells them what these routes take and return.
